supporting_observations.claim: The alerted account tmp.rwong was created at 13:46:16 UTC by emma.stone; the account was then added to the Temp-Staff group.
The account name and recorded Temp-Staff membership are consistent with the stated help-desk practice for temporary accounts. The provided records do not show an administrator-group grant.
The creation event uses emma.stone's logon ID 0xfa52c51, which matches a DC-PIN-01 network logon for emma from 10.51.10.24 shortly before the creation.

Before the account was created, emma.stone initiated an RDP connection from WS-ESTONE-01 to FILE-PIN-01 and logged on there. This is unusual against the stated practice that remote administration is done only from WS-RPATEL-01, but the records do not establish that this RDP session was used to create the account.

At 13:42 UTC, FILE-PIN-01 authenticated to WS-ESTONE-01 as emma.stone using NTLM. This occurred after the scheduled svc-billing password-rotation time, but the records do not link that authentication to the billing job or to the account creation.

A separate emma.stone interactive logon session on DC-PIN-01 ended around 14:13 UTC; its logon ID differs from the ID associated with the account creation, and the supplied records do not establish how that session began or what it did.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include the process or command that performed the directory account creation.
The supplied slice does not provide a complete audit of tmp.rwong's group memberships, account configuration, or subsequent use.
The supplied records do not show whether the account creation was requested or approved, or whether the FILE-PIN-01 RDP session was authorized.
The supplied records do not show the svc-billing password rotation or the manual BillingSync job update.
claims_not_established: Whether tmp.rwong was requested for a legitimate business purpose.
Whether emma.stone's account or session was compromised or whether she acted with malicious intent.
Whether the RDP session to FILE-PIN-01 or the DC-PIN-01 session was connected to the creation of tmp.rwong.
Whether tmp.rwong received additional privileges or was used after creation.
Whether the FILE-PIN-01 authentication was part of the scheduled BillingSync update.
additional_evidence_needed: The help-desk request, approval, or ticket associated with tmp.rwong.
DC directory auditing and endpoint process telemetry identifying the tool and source process used to create the account and change group membership.
Complete group-membership and account-change history for tmp.rwong, plus sign-in and activity records after creation.
RDP session and process activity from FILE-PIN-01, including evidence of any BillingSync job update.
Authentication and session-start details for emma.stone's DC-PIN-01 interactive session.
unrelated_findings: WS-ESTONE-01 made proxy requests to public.tableau.com and dbeaver.io; these show browsing requests, not evidence of software installation or use. Handle separately from this account alert. (T068-00042, T068-00044)
Firefox on WS-ESTONE-01 accessed scontent.xx.fbcdn.net. This is separate from the account creation and does not establish malicious activity. (T068-00024, T068-00029)
